mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( order_id, toss_order_id, amount, payment_status ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{tossOrderId}, #{amount}, #{paymentStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id, order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, amount, payment_method, payment_status, approved_at, failed_reason FROM payment WHERE toss_order_id = #{tossOrderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET payment_key = #{paymentKey}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, payment_status = 'PAID', approved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
UPDATE payment SET payment_status = 'FAILED', failed_reason = #{failedReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE toss_order_id = #{tossOrderId}
